questions.question_text: If you are the first to arrive at a serious road accident, what should you do first?
options: Move the casualties immediately
Check for danger and ensure the site is safe
Call your insurance company
Try to start their car engine
questions.explanation: Personal safety and securing the scene from further accidents is the priority before helping others.

questions.question_text: What is the very first thing you should do if you are the first person to arrive at a serious collision?
options: Attempt to move the injured people out of their vehicles
Check for any dangers and ensure the scene is safe
Immediately call your insurance company
Start giving people water to drink
questions.explanation: The safety of yourself and others is the priority. Do not move injured people unless they are in immediate danger of fire or explosion.

questions.question_text: If you are the first person to arrive at an accident scene, what is the first thing you should do?
options: Call the emergency services immediately
Remove the injured people from their vehicles
Warn other traffic and ensure the scene is safe
Attempt to provide first aid
questions.explanation: Before helping, you must prevent further collisions by warning oncoming traffic.

questions.question_text: What is the priority when arriving first at the scene of a road accident?
options: Move the vehicles to the side of the road
Check for dangers and ensure your own safety
Immediately try to move injured people
Collect insurance details from all drivers
questions.explanation: Personal safety is the highest priority; you cannot help others if you become a casualty yourself.

questions.question_text: If you are the first person to reach the scene of an accident, what is the most important first step?
options: Check for any bleeding
Call the emergency services immediately
Warn other drivers of the danger
Try to move the injured people to safety
questions.explanation: Ensuring the scene is safe and preventing further accidents is the immediate priority before helping others.

questions.question_text: What is the top priority when you arrive at a traffic accident site?
options: Assessing the damage to the vehicles
Prioritizing the safety of yourself and other road users
Writing down the names of the drivers
Moving the vehicles to the side of the road
questions.explanation: Safety comes first. You must manage the traffic and ensure no further collisions occur before assisting those involved.
